privacy_policy_content: We use your account information to provide the So-mails service. We protect your data and do not sell your personal information.
terms_of_service_content: By using So-mails, you agree to use the service lawfully and to keep your account credentials secure.
terms_intro: These terms define the rules for using So-mails. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms.
terms_account_content: You must provide accurate information and keep your credentials confidential. You are responsible for activity from your account and must notify us of unauthorized access.
terms_provider_content: You authorize So-mails to access the mailboxes you connect. You must have the necessary rights to those accounts and comply with their providers' terms.
terms_tracking_content: You are responsible for your recipients, email content, and sending volume. Open tracking depends on image loading and may be limited by email providers or clients.
terms_acceptable_use_content: You must not use So-mails to send spam, fraudulent, illegal, misleading, hateful content, or content that infringes others' rights. We may restrict or suspend accounts in case of abuse.
terms_plans_content: Limits and features depend on your selected plan. Applicable prices and conditions are shown at checkout. We will communicate material changes to affected users.
terms_termination_content: You may stop using the service and request account deletion. We may suspend or terminate an account for violating these terms or creating a risk to the service.
terms_liability_content: We make reasonable efforts to maintain the service, but do not guarantee permanent availability or delivery or opening of every email. You remain responsible for your communications and legal obligations.
terms_contact_content: For questions about these terms, contact us at contact@so-mails.com.
privacy_subtitle: Your data belongs to you. We protect it, we never sell it.
privacy_principle_1_description: We never store your email bodies or attachments. Only events (sent, opened) are recorded.
privacy_principle_2_description: Your data is never shared, sold, or used for advertising purposes. Never.
privacy_principle_3_description: Full GDPR compliance and adherence to major international privacy regulations. Your data is hosted in Europe.
privacy_data_intro: Here's exactly what we collect and why:
privacy_data_email_purpose: To create your account and send you notifications
privacy_data_email_retention: Kept as long as your account exists
privacy_data_metadata_purpose: Recipient, subject, send date, read status
privacy_data_metadata_retention: Kept according to your plan (7 days to unlimited)
privacy_data_events_purpose: Date and time of opening, device (desktop/mobile)
privacy_data_connection_purpose: IP address and browser for your account security
privacy_not_collected_1: The full content of your emails
privacy_compliance_intro: We comply with major data protection regulations worldwide:
privacy_compliance_1_description: Full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation
privacy_compliance_2_description: Respect for the California Consumer Privacy Act
privacy_compliance_3_description: Compliant with Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act
privacy_security_2: Secure OAuth2 authentication for Gmail and Outlook
privacy_security_3: Access tokens encrypted in the database
privacy_rights_intro: Under GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy_right_1_description: Download all your data at any time from your account
privacy_right_2_description: Modify your personal information directly in your profile
privacy_right_3_description: Delete your account and all your data in one click
privacy_right_4_description: Export your data in JSON or CSV format
privacy_cookies_description: We only use essential cookies to keep your session active. No tracking cookies, no advertising cookies.
privacy_contact_description: For questions about this privacy policy or your personal data:
privacy_contact_response: We commit to responding within 48 hours.
